title: Procedural GLSL Morphing Sculpture
tagline: Simplex 4D noise vertex displacement reacting dynamically to pointer velocity.
description: An experimental organic 3D shape displaced in vertex shaders using mathematical 4D noise fields. The sculpture shifts between liquid chrome, obsidian, and matte clay based on user proximity and audio frequencies.
interactiveDetails: Mouse inertia velocity mapping to noise frequency, chromatic aberration lens toggle, and screenshot export.
highlightMetricOrFeature: Pure GPU-computed displacement: 0% CPU thread load
